sources.author: Kodex
patch_list: Repaints every dark surface — background, cards, dialogs, popups, header and the navigation bar — to true black.
Forces time-stretching off for artifact-free playback at 1x speed.
Locks the audio output to AAudio (low latency), overriding the device preference.
Enables bitstream audio passthrough (digital output) to an external DAC or receiver.
Normalizes loudness across tracks using track mode with peak protection.
Buffers 3 seconds of stream ahead to reduce stalls on flaky networks.
Suppresses the What's New changelog dialog shown after app updates.
Enables every experimental feature flag regardless of its stored value.
Sets libVLC to maximum verbosity (-vvv) for troubleshooting playback.
